parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the no-network and no-source constraints, the need to observe the provided CLI normally, and the need to produce an original executable.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: After initial local probing, it split all command behavior discovery across six subagents and left implementation for the parent or a later delegate after reports returned.
parallel.implementation: No final source implementation was produced. The visible child work consisted of behavior probing reports, and the parent was still consuming those reports at cancellation.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: There was no observed integration of child outputs into source, no final build, and the packaged artifact remained non-buildable for the evaluator.
parallel.verification: The run collected behavioral observations but did not reach an implemented candidate or evaluator-aligned verification before cancellation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The replacement executable was never created from the reports; official evaluation completed as compile_failed with all 846 tests not run.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same behavioral reverse-engineering task, no external source rule, no network/cached crates limitation, and original implementation requirement.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single main agent owned probing, synthesis, and the intended pure-std Rust implementation without delegation or child handoffs.
serial.implementation: The serial agent developed a detailed pure-std implementation model but remained in additional edge-case probing and did not write source before cancellation.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No new source, build pipeline, or replacement executable was delivered, so the artifact stayed essentially the starting workspace.
serial.verification: Verification stayed at behavioral probes against the original binary; there was no candidate implementation to compile or test.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also ended before implementation, and official evaluation completed as compile_failed with all 846 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the reverse-engineering requirement and the need for a fresh behavioral reimplementation under no-source and no-network constraints.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same task and constraints, including that a pure-std Rust implementation would be needed after probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference explains the official outcome; both understood the main obligation but neither delivered code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed the task into six command-family probing assignments, with implementation deferred to the parent or a later delegate.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept ownership in the main trajectory, maintaining a single probing and implementation-planning thread with no subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a coordination boundary around investigation results, while serial kept the same knowledge and future implementation ownership local.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were probing-oriented and returned one large aggregate behavior report that exceeded the display limit.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial accumulated probing results in one context and converted them into an implementation model without a child handoff boundary.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The main context difference is not a missing requirement but the parallel parent having to reduce a bulk report before it could implement.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned to implement after probing but did not transition from report consumption to source writing before cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial formed a pure-std Rust implementation plan but continued probing and likewise never wrote the replacement code.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths stopped before code creation; parallel's stoppage followed a delegated report-reduction step, serial's followed continued local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The six subagents completed and produced an aggregate result, but the result was too large for immediate consumption and was being paged.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; all observations remained in the main agent context until cancellation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an additional receive-and-reduce step for a huge result, whereas serial had no join or child-result handoff to manage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children probed in isolated temporary environments and did not produce concurrent source writes or mergeable implementation components.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no shared-worker writes and no integration of a replacement implementation before the artifact was packaged.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run shows a write collision or integrated source tree; the key difference is the absence of shared-state merge risk in serial.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel collected observation evidence but never produced an implementation to run through integrated or official-style acceptance before packaging.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also performed observation probes only and had no implemented candidate to compile or test before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both official evaluations failed at compile time; parallel's verification shortfall followed report consumption, serial's followed unfinished local probing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel spent the budget on local probing, a six-agent probe swarm, and subsequent report paging, then was cancelled.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial spent a comparable budget on sequential probing and planning, then was cancelled at an active step.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but the parallel closure pressure was specifically mediated by the swarm result lifecycle while serial remained a single unfinished stream.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant. Both modes have completed official evaluations with solution_passed false, compile_failed, and 0/846 tests run. The concrete process difference is that parallel inserted six delegated probing reports and a large handoff-reduction stage before implementation, while serial kept probing and planning locally; neither mode wrote and built the required replacement executable.
parallel_contributors: Research-only parallel fan-out deferred implementation until after subagent reports.
The aggregate subagent handoff was too large to reduce before cancellation.
serial_contributors: The serial run kept a local pure-std implementation plan but continued probing instead of writing source before cancellation.
ordinary_implementation_differences: No completed implementation exists in either trajectory, so ordinary coding defects cannot be separated from non-delivery.

candidates.reason: The parent explicitly planned to write the implementation itself or delegate it after probing, so implementation was delayed rather than unowned.
No separate component implementations were produced, so there was no concrete integration object lacking an owner.
No complete components or entry-point source existed for final packaging; the failure occurred before assembly ownership became concrete.
The parent retained end-to-end responsibility and the breakdown was the research-first phase and oversized handoff, not an unassigned pipeline transition.
There was not one mandatory serial preflight or oracle gate; the parent launched a broad parallel investigation phase.

The parent explicitly made six concurrent investigators cover command groups first and deferred implementation until after their reports, leaving the later implementation stage unfinished at cancellation.
candidates.realized_consequence: Implementation started too late and no replacement source or buildable executable existed when the parallel parent was cancelled.
candidates.near_match_reason: The adverse episode is better described as a first-phase investigation plan than as proof that the number of workers alone exhausted the budget.

candidates.reason: The direct boundary was a research-only phase and later handoff overload; there was no separate auxiliary allocation starving an active implementation path.
Six agents and a timeout are screening signals, but the directly evidenced problem is investigation-before-implementation plus bulk handoff, not an independent breadth-exhaustion episode.
No single child was assigned an overbroad indispensable implementation; each child had a bounded probing scope and the aggregate reports completed.
The child prompts carried the relevant task rules, executable path, isolation expectations, and observation-only constraints; no known requirement was omitted and followed into unusable work.
The children produced independent behavior reports rather than interoperating components, so no missing file, API, or namespace contract caused incompatibility.
The needed information was stored in the aggregate report and paged via result files; the evidence does not show a finding disappeared in transfer.
The completed swarm returned a report exceeding the display limit, forcing the parent into multiple paged reads; cancellation arrived before the report was reduced into implementation.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parent consumed the remaining decision window paging report chunks and never distilled the available findings into source code.
candidates.near_match_reason: The handoff was available and contained the needed observations; the issue was volume and decision structure, not missing transfer.
